February 21
2015-02-21T00:55:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-people/february-21-3062

Every year on February 21, many of us try to relive the revolution fought in 1952. We wonder about the past, try to understand the thoughts and actions of our ancestors; make an effort to comprehend the passion and love they nurtured for the language. Following the footsteps of the famous names and change makers of the time, we went back to some of the historical grounds where ideas were cooked up. As we explore the streets of the old part of town, we stumble across age-old gems that have faded into the background. Today's Star People is filled with history, wonder and excitement. Delve into the past and find out where it all happened.
